channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Former U.S. Air Force officer accused of training Chinese military pilots
item.description: A retired U.S. Air Force officer who once trained American fighter pilots is facing federal charges for training Chinese military pilots to fly in combat operations, according to a criminal complaint in federal court.

item.title: Honolulu firefighters quickly douse flames at Maunawili home
item.description: Firefighters quickly brought a fire under control early this afternoon in a Maunawili neighborhood.

item.title: Iranian Americans in Los Angeles find hope in U.S.-Israeli strikes on Iran
item.description: LOS ANGELES >> It was Friday night in Los Angeles when Sam Yebri’s phone started to light up with texts from friends and family. Explosions in Tehran, Iran, which is 11 1/2 hours ahead of Los Angeles. Israeli ministers warning of Iran’s possible retaliation for U.S. and Israeli military strikes.

item.title: Dre Bullock’s buzzer-beater lifts Hawaii over Cal State Fullerton
item.description: Quandre “Dre” Bullock hit the winning 3-point shot as time expired to deliver the Hawaii basketball team an 87-85 victory over Cal State Fullerton at Titan Gym on the Orange County, Calif., campus.

item.title: Shark warning issued for Laniakea Beach on Oahu
item.description: Honolulu Ocean Safety Department issued a shark warning this afternoon at Laniakea Beach on Oahu’s North Shore after a non-aggressive 4-foot shark was spotted swimming along the shoreline.

item.title: Ewa Beach meth trafficker sentenced to over 14 years in prison
item.description: A 46-year-old Ewa Beach man was sentenced to over 14 years in federal prison for drug and firearms offenses, the U.S. Attorney’s Office in Hawaii announced Friday.

item.title: Boy dies after being struck by vehicle in Hawaii Kai
item.description: A boy was killed after being struck by a vehicle today in Hawaii Kai, police said.

item.title: Man, 33, arrested for alleged slashing of cop’s neck in Waikiki
item.description: A 33-year-old man was arrested this afternoon on suspicion of first-degree attempted murder of a law enforcement officer in Waikiki.

item.title: Rainbow Wahine rout Cal State Fullerton on senior night
item.description: The Hawaii women’s basketball team closed out the home slate of the regular season with a 67-49 win over Cal State Fullerton tonight at Bankoh Arena at Stan Sheriff Center.

item.title: Man robbed at gunpoint in Palolo
item.description: Police say two males robbed a 37-year-old man at gunpoint early this morning in Palolo.
